### Red team · Reply

Event: `e214647f7c030c18f1fbe6cd46c90b76` · 2026-09-25T23:13:49Z

> Scope: 49f99eca9 and 04289a39e, read against the plan and the model. The uncommitted commit-3 work in the tree was not reviewed.
> 
> Safety core, checked:
> - dma_release (dma.rs). S is Account::dma_mapped plus the slot of every Live run held by pid. It pools only when confirmed == S in this same call, with the P1-1b assert on each run. dma_reset returns false for a quarantined or non-virtio slot, so a quarantined slot never counts as confirmed. Otherwise every held run is Quarantined with holder None, and each slot that failed to confirm is flagged and doomed. This matches the model after round 1.
> - DMA_OWNER frames can't leave early. alloc_contiguous claims them for DMA_OWNER. The only ways back to the pool are free_contiguous, called from pool() (in dma_release and dma_drop_run), which asserts the owner. release_owned_frames and uncharge_all_frames only touch Some(pid). Pass 1 of release_all_memory_for_process leaves DMA_OWNER alone. unmap skips is_dma_frame. check_owned_range still requires owner == pid, so IPC lend and transfer refuse DMA pages. process_map refuses explicitly, and legacy lend_memory refuses. owned_mapping's new DMA branch only serves unmap and set_flags (mem.rs:1237/1264); I grepped for every caller.
> - Accounting. dma_new_run charges the run's budget directly (outside account.frames), and process_ended's uncharge doesn't include those pages. pool() uncharges only a live budget. dma_migrate_quarantine runs after return_carve in destroy_marked (N1), using a plain charge that expects I5. Account::NONE resets dma_mapped for a reused PID.
> - OD6. terminate_process and kill_process, which R10's end_process reaches, call destroy_quarantined_devices right after terminate. So no live object names a quarantined base when user code runs next, and dma_slot_of's assert can't be reached from user space. The only other terminate caller is shutdown, where that doesn't matter.
> - Window and boot. The loader pre-shares the tables. map_kernel_page allocates nothing and asserts the slot is empty. The PLIC assert and the ABI const asserts hold: on rv32 the window ends exactly at PROCESS_AREA, and on rv64 it sits in root 511.
> 
> P2-1: ordering. On its own, commit 2 still lets legacy MapMemory reach a virtio slot under a grant, and that mapping doesn't join S. A grant holder could program DMA into its dma_alloc frames without its death ever resetting the device. That is the P2-1 hole the plan closes in commit 3. Commit 2 must not be merged, or treated as a safe bisect point, without commit 3. Please say so in commit 3's message.
> 
> P3-1: dma-reset-deaf is only built on rv64 (commit message). Build rv32 with it too before the dma-reset cases.
> 
> P3-2: State::Live's doc says "(or by none yet: it is being set up)", but no Live run ever has holder None. Trim it.
> 
> Not run: no DMA boot case exists before commit 3, so there was no bite to plant. The attack case (the must-fail run) is for commit 3's review.
